en.headline: Haze today: stay indoors more
body: Stay indoors as much as you can today.
Get help at once if your chest hurts, you are breathless or dizzy.
en.passage: people with chronic heart or lung disease should reduce outdoor activity and stay indoors where possible

ms.headline: Jerebu hari ini: duduk di dalam rumah
body: Duduk di dalam rumah seberapa boleh hari ini.
Simpan ubat anda dekat dengan anda.
Dapatkan bantuan segera jika dada sakit, sesak nafas atau pening.
ms.passage: people with chronic heart or lung disease should reduce outdoor activity and stay indoors where possible

zh.headline: 今天有烟霾：多待在室内
body: 如果胸口痛、喘不过气或头晕，马上求助。
zh.passage: people with chronic heart or lung disease should reduce outdoor activity and stay indoors where possible
